bullets.title: MCP 2026-07-28 specification — stateless servers, MCP Apps, improved auth
bullets.summary: Official MCP blog describes the 2026-07-28 spec moving MCP to a stateless model with MCP Apps and better auth; migration of hosted servers is ongoing. Carried forward; not new in the last 24h.
bullets.how: The Construct: audit Hermes/Claude MCP connectors for stateful-session assumptions. PRAGMA: migration checklist is a sellable deliverable. Brand 9 Signs: no direct use.

bullets.title: Claude Sonnet 5.5 — 1.05M context, $2/$10 per 1M tokens, ~30% faster

bullets.how: The Construct: default model for scheduled routines and doc/deck/sheet generation. Brand 9 Signs: cheaper proposal/quote drafting. PRAGMA: cost baseline for client builds.

bullets.title: 6sense launches an MCP server for GTM intelligence (date unverified)
bullets.summary: 6sense exposes its go-to-market intelligence to AI agents via MCP; a feed listing surfaced in today's search but the publish date could not be confirmed as inside 24h.
bullets.how: PRAGMA: example of B2B data vendors going agent-native, useful for client prospecting offers. The Construct / Brand 9 Signs: no direct use.

praxis_lesson: Second thin day in a row: web search surfaces no verifiable 24h news, so label carried-forward and undated items explicitly rather than padding; the durable signal is vendors shipping MCP servers, which keeps raising the value of a stateless-spec-ready connector layer.
